exposure: Delivery in perinatal intensive/intermediate care centers for high-risk women
Antepartum anemia treatment (iron supplements, parenteral iron)
Cord ligation timing (>1 min if baby adapts well)
Uterine massage and controlled umbilical cord traction
PPH management protocols and simulation training
Pre-transfusion examination (standard lab tests, viscoelastic methods)
Stocking and immediate availability of blood products (plasma, erythrocytes, fibrinogen)
Correction of hypothermia, acidosis, and ionized calcium levels
Erythrocyte blood products for target hemoglobin
outcome: Shortened duration of third stage of labor
Effective management of PPH complications (e.g., coagulopathy, hypovolemia)
cohort: The recommendations target pregnant women and women experiencing peripartum haemorrhage (PPH), especially those with identified risk factors.
finding: This consensus document provides comprehensive interdisciplinary recommendations for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of peripartum haemorrhage (PPH), encompassing pre-delivery planning, prophylactic measures, and acute management strategies including pharmacological, interventional, and blood product support.
mod_finding: The guidelines include recommendations on delaying cord ligation if the baby adapts well, and the prophylactic administration of uterotonics and tranexamic acid for both vaginal and caesarean deliveries to reduce PPH risk.
